description:
Use this when the user wants ONE clip of an exact stretch of a video: "clip 1:02:10 to 1:03:00" (3730 to
3780 seconds), or a match from get_moments. Makes one captioned vertical clip of exactly that stretch.
Not for: RipClip picking highlights (find_clips) or searching a topic (find_moments). Spends Horizon Units for
just those minutes: call estimate_hu with the same range as range_start / range_end first, show the number
and pass the approved amount as max_hu (a failed job gives it back). Returns job_id; job_status waits for it.

clipping_preset.description: Preset id or name from list_clipping_presets; empty is the default, "none" the standard look.

end_seconds.description: Clip end in seconds from the video start. The clip must be 3 seconds to 5 minutes long.

max_hu.description: Horizon Units the user approved, from estimate_hu; a higher cost is refused.

project_id.description: Id of the video, from list_projects.

request_key.description: Optional unique string; repeating it returns the same job.

start_seconds.description: Clip start in seconds from the video start, e.g. 3730 for 1:02:10.

name: clip_range
title: Clip a time range
